definitions.explanation: a line that is neither horizontal nor vertical; a slanted line
a line drawn through text to indicate deletion or cancellation

examples.japanese: {斜線|しゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
⟦{図形|ずけい}→図形：04036_zukei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{斜線|しゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: To show the area by adding diagonal lines to the figure.

examples.english: Please draw a slash through items that do not apply on the application form.

notes:
{斜線|しゃせん} refers to a diagonal or slanted line, and also to a line drawn through text to indicate deletion.

FORMS:
{斜|しゃ} (slanted) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {斜線|しゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a diagonal line / to cross out
- {斜線|しゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to add a slash mark
- {斜線|しゃせん}⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧: hatched area (in diagrams)

PRACTICAL USAGE:
On Japanese forms (⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧, ⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧), fields that don't apply are filled with a diagonal slash rather than left blank. This prevents unauthorized additions.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧: straight line
- ⟦{曲線|きょくせん}→曲線：05441_kyokusen⟧: curved line
- ⟦{対角線|たいかくせん}→対角線：08121_taikakusen⟧: diagonal of a shape
- ⟦{水平線|すいへいせん}→水平線：13311_suiheisen⟧: horizontal line
